page.overview:
Who is Bob?

Bob is a InGen Hunter who appears as a minor character in The Lost World: Jurassic Park section of LEGO Jurassic World. He was tricked by his fellow hunter, Josh, who pretended to be a Velociraptor and grabbed his foot. He and Josh later escaped together and managed to survive the attack, despite no hunters surviving in the film.
